escalations.summary: Contributor liquiditygooner reports ~10 tasks stuck in review for ~24h with no verification movement, asking whether verification is paused. Public board context does not state a verification-pipeline pause (the known pause on PostfiatL1V2 is task generation, not verification, and is unrelated to this member's queue). Request the board manager check the verification worker/pipeline state and confirm whether reviews are processing, so contributors with queues can be told whether this is a systemic stall or per-task lag.

Follow-up to pending verification-stall escalation from liquiditygooner, with triage detail that changes the hypothesis: member confirms no task-sync warning present, so the known client sync-lag defect does not explain this. Concrete timeline: last on-chain reward payment 07:52 UTC the prior day with nothing since; 10 tasks sitting in review spanning roughly 14h (newest) to 30h (oldest); member can enumerate task IDs on request. Ask the board manager to check whether the verification/reward pipeline has stalled since ~07:52 UTC and whether these 10 reviews are processing, to distinguish a systemic stop from per-task lag.

Task-ID follow-up to the pending verification-stall escalation from liquiditygooner (10 tasks in review, last on-chain reward 07:52 UTC prior day). Member supplied the concrete rows, oldest first: a3c9ddc9, 7cdbc2b9, 9f9aeae0, d3136e67, effebb32, 5dfa3537, fd8fdca2, 19ec2d5e, b63e8911, 484adfad (all task_-prefixed; full IDs available on request). No sync warning present on their client, so sync-lag is ruled out. Ask the board manager to check the verification/reward pipeline state against these specific rows to distinguish a systemic stall since ~07:52 UTC from per-task lag, and to report back so the member can be given a straight answer.
